methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); pharmaceutical signals

BASE.desc: EPS +58.8%/yr (FY20 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr ex-FY15 ex-FY17 ex-FY19 median

BULL.desc: EPS +58.8%/yr (FY10-FY18 ex-FY15 ex-FY17 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +58.8%/yr (best 2-yr run FY10-FY18 ex-FY15 ex-FY17); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: BMY (retrospective, 2020-03-13) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 6.49x (94.5% downside to Bear $3 / +14.6% upside to Bull $63) | Adj composite 2.75 vs market 3.30: gap -0.55 [OVERVALUED] | +240% above the EPP floor $16 (19x FY20E $0.85) | Conservative 2-yr case: -2.0% total (-1.0%/yr) | At 64.7x FY20E the 15% hurdle price $73 sits above the BULL case; U.S. revenues +42.2% in Q4 2019, forward revenues +54.9-62.6% (FY20 revenue guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
